head: Samsung Now Brief may get Daily Briefing with automatic reminders
dek: Screenshots shared by SamMobile show a Daily Briefing in Now Brief that pulls bills, deadlines and appointments from your apps and turns them into reminders, Android Authority reports. Samsung hasn't confirmed it.
details: The leaked cards sort items into Finance, Work and Productivity, and Mobility and Traffic, with countdowns. Examples include a Netflix payment notice with the amount, an apartment maintenance fee, a work training deadline from an email and service appointments. It is tied to One UI 9.5, and it appeared on a leaked list of Galaxy AI Premium features, so it may need the paid plan. No release date is known.
where: Galaxy phones with One UI 9.5, not announced
means: If you use a Galaxy phone, Now Brief may start reminding you of bills and deadlines on its own, possibly only with a paid AI plan.
todo: Nothing to do yet; the feature isn't out or confirmed.
